items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 141:1
items.html: (To the question) What is an addition and not the principle? What is corrected in the Partzufim in a fixed manner is discerned as the principle of the Partzuf, and they are the six vessels HGT NHY of ZA, and the aspect of the Malchut of the Nukva, which is the crown of the Yesod of ZA. From the aspect of the vessels they are discerned as KHB HGT of ZA until the chest, and the aspect of the Keter of the Nukva, which is the point of the chest. And everything that ZON attain beyond these aspects, namely, the aspect of the NHY of the vessels of the Neshama, Chaya, Yechida of ZA, with the GAR of the lights; and likewise all the nine of the vessels of the NRNCHY of the Nukva, with the nine of the lights — all these are discerned as additions and are not the principle of the Partzuf, because they are not fixed in it, but depend on the good deeds of the lower ones. (Item 34).
